Coastal towns adapt as tides rise

By Priya Raman

2 November 2024

Councils along the eastern shoreline have brought forward sea-defence work by nearly a decade, citing survey data that shows erosion outpacing every projection made in the last review.

The revised programme covers eleven settlements and is expected to run into the next parliament, with funding drawn from a mix of national grants and local levies.

We are no longer planning for a distant problem.

What changes

  • Raised embankments
  • Managed retreat in two villages
  • New tidal gates
